    Profile

    Olga is a young girl from a tribe of beast-people who live in the darkest depths of the Saga Region. She despises alchemy, which goes against the laws of nature, and the humans who use it. As you'd expect for someone who's grown up in the wild, she possesses phenomenal physical agility. When treated like a lady though, she'll also show a cute, "girly" side...

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 173cm
    Weight: 58kg
    Birthday: Jan 1
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Fruit, new things
    Hobbies: Physical exercise
    Illust: 大盛よしを
    CV: 中西優香
